# log_triage.sh - Summarize recurring production errors from mixed application logs
# Usage: ./log_triage.sh [log_file(s)]

set -euo pipefail

# Default to searching current directory if no files provided


FILES="${@:-logs/*.log logs/*.log.gz}"

# Check if files exist
shopt -s nullglob
if [[ ${#FILES[@]} -eq 0 ]]; then
    echo "No log files found matching: $FILES" >&2
    exit 1
fi

# Process all files and extract error signatures
(
    for file in "${FILES[@]}"; do
        if [[ "$file" == *.gz ]]; then
            zcat "$file"
        else
            cat "$file"
        fi
    done
) | \
# Filter: only ERROR level, exclude healthcheck noise
grep -E '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}Z ERROR' | \
grep -v 'healthcheck' | \
# Extract signature: keep up to the first key=value pair, or entire line if none
sed -E 's/\s+[a-zA-Z_]+=[^ ]+.*//' | \
# Count and sort
sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | \
# Format output
awk '{count=$1; $1=""; print count ": " $0}'
```
